description: This file defines a higher-order React component that wraps other components with a backend health check mechanism. It displays a health check UI until the backend is confirmed healthy, relying on a subordinate 'BackendHealthCheck' component, and manages health state based on local storage token presence and callback handlers.

methods.name: withBackendCheck
methods.description: A higher-order component that wraps a given React component, adding backend health check logic. It manages health state and conditionally renders a health check UI.
